items.name: Stephan
items.text: Sprejeli so nas zelo prijazno in osebno. Ves čas smo se počutili dobrodošli. Bilo je zelo mirno in sproščujoče, natanko to, kar smo potrebovali.

whyUs.quote: Ne gre zgolj za predajo ključev. Poskrbimo za vsako podrobnost, da lahko preprosto uživate.
whyUs.feature1Body: Vsak apartma je ročno izbran in ustreza najvišjim standardom.
whyUs.feature2Body: Od prijave do odjave smo vedno na voljo za vas.
whyUs.feature3Body: Vse, kar potrebujete za popoln oddih, vas že čaka.
whyUs.feature4Body: Naši gostje dosledno puščajo 5-zvezdične ocene na vseh platformah.

whoWeAre.label: Kdo smo
whoWeAre.heading: Butična agencija za upravljanje nepremičnin
whoWeAre.para1: Solar Living je butična agencija za upravljanje nepremičnin v Umagu, v Istri, na hrvaški obali Jadrana, ki upravlja skrbno izbran portfelj vrhunskih apartmajev in vil tako za goste kot za lastnike nepremičnin.
whoWeAre.para2: Gostom ponujamo skrbno izbrane apartmaje in vile po vsem Umagu, ki jih vzdržujemo na enaki ravni udobja, čistoče in pozorne postrežbe. To potrjujejo tudi naše ocene na Booking.com in Airbnb.
whoWeAre.para3: Lastnikom nepremičnin v Umagu in po vsej Istri Solar Living ponuja celovito upravljanje: profesionalno fotografijo, upravljanje oglasov na vseh večjih platformah, 24-urno komunikacijo z gosti, usklajevanje čiščenja, dinamično oblikovanje cen in mesečna poročila o uspešnosti, vse zasnovano tako, da povečuje donos in zagotavlja brezskrbnost lastnikov.
whoWeAre.para4: Solar Living je del skupine Solar Group, skupaj z <link>Solar Creative</link>, marketinško agencijo s sedežem v Dubaju.

ownersCta.label: Lastniki nepremičnin
ownersCta.heading: Imate nepremičnino v Istri?
ownersCta.body: Pridružite se našemu portfelju in boste deležni celotnega upravljanja, zagotovljene skrbi ter izjemnih rezultatov. Mi poskrbimo za vse.

location.label: Kje smo
location.heading: Umag, Istra
location.body: Umag, ki leži na severozahodni konici Istre, je čudovito srednjeveško mestece s kristalno čistim Jadranskim morjem, vrhunsko gastronomijo in sproščenim mediteranskim vzdušjem. Popolna destinacija za resnično poživljajoč oddih.

apt1.name: Elaine's View
apt1.description: Prva linija do morja. Panoramski razgled na Jadran, sončne zahode in staro mestno jedro Umaga.

reviews.name: Tania
reviews.text: Apartma je bil čist in udoben, z balkona pa smo imeli razgled na večerne sončne zahode nad Jadranom in starim mestnim jedrom Umaga. Umag je odlično izhodišče za raziskovanje Istre, tudi za enodnevne izlete v Italijo. Vreme je bilo odlično, zgodovina zanimiva, pokrajina pa čudovita.

reviews.name: Stephan
reviews.text: Sprejeli so nas zelo prijazno in osebno. Velik, dobro razporejen apartma z razgledom na morje. Balkon gleda proti morju, poleg pa je še stranski balkon, kar je zelo praktično. Bilo je zelo mirno.

reviews.name: Jana
reviews.text: Popolna nastanitev. Vrhunski apartma s čudovitim razgledom na morje. Tik pred stavbo je mestna plaža z lahkim dostopom do morja, kjer je malo obiskovalcev. Zelo prijazna in profesionalna komunikacija z gostiteljem. Vsekakor se bomo vrnili.

apt2.name: Stella's Garden
apt2.description: Bivanje v pritličju ene najlepših novih stavb v Umagu, z zasebnim mediteranskim vrtom.

reviews.name: Peter
reviews.text: Vse je bilo brezhibno čisto in zelo sodobno, počutili smo se skoraj kot prvi gostje. Izjemno prijazen gostitelj, vedno takoj na voljo, z zelo hitrimi odgovori na vprašanja.

reviews.name: Jehona
reviews.text: Vse je odlično, boljše kot v petzvezdičnem hotelu. Priporočam vsem. Ničesar takega še nisem videla. Lastnik je bil zelo prijazen in nam je vse pokazal.

reviews.name: Maciej
reviews.text: Toplo priporočam. Prostoren pritlični apartma z udobnimi posteljami, dobro opremljeno kuhinjo, klimatsko napravo in dvema kopalnicama. Velika terasa z dodeljenim parkirnim mestom. 2 minuti z avtom do nakupovalnih centrov, 4 do 5 minut do najbližje plaže.

apt3.name: Sabbia
apt3.description: Stilsko zatočišče v srcu Umaga, le nekaj korakov od starega mestnega jedra, z zasebnim balkonom in garažnim parkirnim mestom.

apt4.name: Villa De La Maria
apt4.description: Zasebna vila v Umagu z bazenom, vrtom in zunanjo kuhinjo, zasnovana za sproščeno povezavo notranjosti z zunanjostjo.

apt5.name: Solar Apartment Umag V
apt5.description: Čudovita nova pridobitev v naši ponudbi, podrobnosti kmalu sledijo. Kontaktirajte nas, da boste med prvimi izvedeli, kdaj bo ta nastanitev na voljo.

apt6.name: Solar Apartment Umag VI
apt6.description: Izjemna nastanitev, ki jo trenutno pripravljamo za našo ponudbo. Kontaktirajte nas, če želite izvedeti več.

story.label: Who We Are
story.para1: Solar Living is a boutique property management company based in Umag, on the beautiful northwestern coast of Istria, Croatia. We manage a carefully selected portfolio of premium apartments and villas, properties we personally vet, prepare, and maintain to the highest standard.
story.para2: We are part of the Solar Group, alongside Solar Creative, our marketing agency. This means every property in our portfolio benefits not just from management expertise, but from professional photography, branding, and digital marketing that most property managers simply don't offer.
story.para3: Our mission is simple: exceptional experiences for guests, absolute peace of mind for owners, and properties that consistently earn top-rated reviews.

guests.label: For Guests
guests.q1: Where are the Solar Living apartments located?
guests.a1: Both apartments are located in Umag, a charming coastal town on the northwestern tip of Istria, Croatia. Elaine's View is in Umag Old Town, first row to the sea. Stella's Garden is in a brand new building in a quiet residential area of Umag, 4–5 minutes from the beach.
guests.q2: What is included in the apartments?
guests.a2: All apartments are fully equipped with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, Smart TV, and fresh linen. Elaine's View also includes a washing machine and sea view terrace. Stella's Garden features a private Mediterranean garden and terrace.
guests.q3: How do I book an apartment?
guests.a3: You can send a booking inquiry directly through our website. Click "Check Availability & Book" on any apartment, fill in your details, and send via WhatsApp or email. We confirm availability and handle everything from there — no third-party platform needed.
guests.a4: Yes. Both Elaine's View and Stella's Garden include dedicated parking.
guests.q5: What are the guest ratings for Solar Living apartments?
guests.a5: Elaine's View holds a 9.9/10 rating on Booking.com and 5.0/5 on Airbnb. Stella's Garden holds a 9.8/10 on Booking.com and 5.0/5 on Airbnb.
guests.q6: How far are the apartments from the beach?
guests.a6: Elaine's View is first row to the sea — there is a city beach directly in front of the building. Stella's Garden is approximately 4–5 minutes by car from the nearest beach.
guests.q7: Can I take day trips from Umag?
guests.a7: Absolutely. Umag is ideally located for day trips to Venice (approx. 2 hours), Pula, Rovinj, and the Brijuni Islands. Italy's Aquileia and Trieste are also within easy reach.

owners.label: For Property Owners
owners.q1: What does Solar Living's property management service include?
owners.a1: We offer full-service property management including professional photography, multi-platform listing management (Airbnb, Booking.com, direct), 24/7 guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, dynamic pricing optimization, and monthly performance reporting.
owners.q2: Which areas does Solar Living operate in?
owners.a2: We currently operate in Umag, Istria, Croatia, and are expanding across the Istrian peninsula.
owners.q3: How do I get started with Solar Living as a property owner?
owners.a3: Contact us via WhatsApp or email for a free consultation. We'll visit your property, provide recommendations, and agree on terms — with no commitment required.
owners.q4: Is Solar Living a licensed property management company?
owners.a4: Yes. Solar Living operates under BE CAPITAL, obrt za poslovanje nekretninama, vl. Evan Beaković, OIB: 30760238873, registered in Croatia.
